goal: Implement the smallest portable local integration prototype for one registered Agentarium project/run, then independently verify before real pilot start.

authorization.scope: Preparation now. No paid worker started by this handoff. No merge/release/deployment/new infrastructure or recurring charge.
authorization.source: Peter asks Atlas to continue interface integration and pilot preparation; binding infrastructure input remains missing.

conditional_paths.condition: Only narrow data-input hook after exact bridge mapping review; no layout/visual rewrite.

implementation_slices.scope: Portable loopback-only integration harness using existing reference reducer, explicit local test input, existing catalog/snapshot/tail/archive contract. Distinguish raw accepted input, rejected diagnostics and consumed transport cursor. Local test storage only, no durability guarantee.
implementation_slices.deliverable: A bounded executable with exact start/check commands and machine-readable responses.

implementation_slices.scope: Narrow existing-field consumer adapter. Explicit mapping from canonical work-event fields to legacy display. No invented occurred_at/duration/model/cost; unknown time uses labelled step sequence. Unsupported event kinds visible, never silently dropped.
implementation_slices.deliverable: Actual existing field receives input and identifies simulation/observed/coverage correctly.

implementation_slices.scope: Real one-run pilot only after verified host/storage/auth/producer inputs and Sentinel runtime PASS.
implementation_slices.deliverable: Same actual journal reconstructs same accepted state live and archived.

acceptance.expected: Existing K3/K1 checkers remain green and reducer bytes match verified blob.
Late entry snapshot plus tail equals complete reduction at same cursor, no double effect.
Reconnect, duplicate, gap and invalid Done preserve correct state and report diagnosis.
Archive replay causes no agent execution, provider calls, GitHub writes or command execution.
Loopback prototype clearly labelled test; does not claim production user authentication or environment-level durability.
Costs field visible with exact incomplete-status text and no amounts.
Real pilot remains blocked until journal/diagnostic restore after restart and authorized private access proven.

missing_runtime_inputs: Named execution host/operator and actual start access
Producer authentication and user read access for real observation
forbidden_actions: No new paid service, GitHub App, webhook, secret or permission
No false complete capture, runtime model, timings or full costs
stop_condition: Return exact missing input if environment cannot be bound; never claim real pilot ready from local fixture PASS.
